termsBody:
# yuoyuo Terms of Service

**International release draft · 8 October 2026**

## Operator and eligibility
The service is offered under the yuoyuo brand by its United States operator. Legal operator name, service address and required local representative details must be completed before public launch. These draft terms do not replace disclosures required by applicable law.

You must be at least 18 and meet any higher minimum age required where you live. Do not provide false age information or share an account with a minor. Mainland China is outside our service territory. Location checks can restrict access; users must not circumvent territorial restrictions.

## AI conversations and your choices
Characters are fictional AI systems, not real people, therapists or emergency services. Replies and memories may be inaccurate. You can correct the memories shown in Shared memories. AI responses are not medical, legal or financial advice. Do not rely on them for urgent or consequential decisions.

## Accounts and creator content
Keep credentials secure. Google sign-in, when available, requests identity and email information for authentication; it does not request access to your inbox. You remain responsible for the content you submit and must have permission to use character descriptions, artwork, names, voices and other material.

You retain your rights in your content. You grant yuoyuo a non-exclusive license limited to hosting, processing, displaying and distributing it as needed to provide the service according to your visibility settings. Private content is not licensed for public promotion. Public and link-visible content may be viewed according to their visibility; link-visible content is excluded from public discovery. This does not guarantee AI output is unique or copyrightable.

## Content rules
Do not create or share sexual content involving minors or youthful characters, sexual exploitation, non-consensual intimate material, trafficking, credible threats, targeted harassment, doxxing, terrorist recruitment, instructions facilitating serious harm, or infringing content. Do not impersonate a real person deceptively or upload their intimate images or cloned voice without authorization. Mature labels are classification tools, not permission to violate these rules. Safety protections apply to all membership tiers.

We may restrict content or accounts following reports, policy violations or legal requirements. Reports should identify the character or material and explain the concern. Copyright notices should identify the protected work, disputed material, contact details and basis of ownership or authorization. Appeal and privacy contact: privacy@yuoyuo.app (activation pending; do not send sensitive documents until the address is confirmed operational).

## Fees and changes
International checkout is currently unavailable. No subscription or automatic renewal is created by these terms. If paid services are introduced, total price, currency, tax treatment, benefits, usage limits, renewal, cancellation and applicable refund rights must be shown before purchase. Japanese consumer disclosures and Korean cancellation requirements will be supplied where applicable. Mandatory consumer rights are not waived.

## Ending use and disputes
You can request account deletion and export through account settings. Deletion has a 30-day recovery period; some data may be retained where legally required. We may suspend service for security or lawful reasons and will provide notice and review routes where required. We will announce material policy changes. Nothing here excludes non-waivable consumer protections or remedies in your country. Governing-law and dispute provisions require final operator legal review before launch.
privacyBody:
# yuoyuo Privacy Notice

**International release draft · 8 October 2026**

## Controller and contact
Brand: yuoyuo. Operator country: United States, as supplied by the operator. The legal controller name, service address and any required Japan/Korea representative contact remain pending before public launch. Planned contact: privacy@yuoyuo.app, forwarded to an operator-managed Gmail mailbox. Delivery has not yet been verified.

## Information and purposes
We process email and authentication identifiers to manage accounts; profile and date-of-birth information to enforce age rules; language preferences for personalization; character content, conversations, generated replies and derived memories to provide AI interactions; and security/usage records to operate the service and investigate abuse. Avoid entering sensitive personal information about yourself or others. Google sign-in provides a stable Google account identifier, verified email and basic profile permissions; we do not request Gmail access.

Private conversations and private characters are not public community posts. Public and link-visible content is accessible according to the selected visibility. Authorized operations or moderation access may be necessary for support, security, legal compliance and policy enforcement. Do not claim that private means inaccessible to all service personnel.

## Service providers and international transfers
Hosting, storage, email and AI providers process data necessary to deliver their functions. Chat context can include your messages, character setting and relevant memories. The configured model routing can send this context to a fallback provider if the selected provider fails. Before launch we must publish the actual recipients/processors, purposes, categories, transfer countries and safeguards, and provider retention/training practices. We do not promise zero retention or exclusion from provider training without verified agreements.

Japanese APPI and Korean PIPA requirements may require additional notices, transfer details or consent depending on the actual processing arrangement. This draft is not a substitute for those steps. Future advertising or analytics involving additional tracking will require an updated notice and any applicable consent before activation.

## Retention and deletion
Conversations and memories remain available while required for the account and its selected features. Account deletion currently includes a 30-day recovery period. Backup expiry, log retention and any accounting/security retention schedules must be verified and published before launch; immediate erasure from every backup is not promised. Legally necessary records may be retained with access restricted.

## Your controls
Account settings provide profile controls, language preferences, data export and deletion requests. Shared memories provides corrections to displayed memories; correction history is kept privately for audit and does not itself erase the previous text. You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, withdrawal of applicable consent or review of a refusal, subject to applicable law and identity verification. Do not email passwords or identity documents without a verified, necessary request. You may complain to the competent privacy authority where you live.

## Security and age
We use access controls and transport security, but no system can guarantee perfect security. The service is for adults aged 18 or older and any higher local minimum. A birthday declaration is not government identity verification. Suspected underage accounts should be reported for review. Material changes to this notice will be announced before taking effect where required.
contentPolicyBody: Create and share only content you have the right to use. Sexual content involving minors, sexual violence, non-consensual intimate imagery, impersonation for deception, exploitation, threats, doxxing and instructions for serious harm are prohibited. Do not portray a real person as endorsing or participating in a fictional relationship without permission. Public character submissions are reviewed and may be rejected or removed. Use the reporting contact to flag harmful or infringing material. Age confirmation does not make otherwise prohibited content acceptable.
refundsBody: New purchases and paid subscriptions are not available in the international preview. We do not collect payment card details or redirect users to Afdian. Contact support for questions about an existing purchase; the applicable original purchase terms and mandatory consumer rights still apply. Pricing, renewal, cancellation and refund terms will be published before any new paid offering opens.

ageBody:
# Adult access and content ratings

The service is for adults aged 18 or older and any higher minimum age that applies in their jurisdiction. Users in South Korea who have not reached the applicable local adult threshold must not access adult-restricted material. Public launch requires a local review of age assurance and content classification obligations; a self-declared birthday alone is not proof that these obligations have been met.

Do not misrepresent your age, share your account with minors, or evade age and territorial restrictions. General and mature labels describe themes; they do not override the adult access requirement or permit prohibited content. Sexual content involving minors or youthful characters is prohibited regardless of account tier or fictional framing.
